title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
You're a Workspace Owner on a Slack Business+ plan.
Your organization plans to expand Slack usage to the entire company of 4,000 people, and your security team wants workspace access restricted to company email addresses.
What is the most secure option for onboarding all 4,000 users into Slack?
(Select the best answer.)
option_A: Integrate with a SAML-based identity provider (IdP) and SCIM API connector so that you can pre- provision members to the workspace.
option_B: Enable email signup so that those with an approved company email address can join by clicking your workspace's sign-up link or entering their email on the sign in page.
option_C: Turn on Just-In-Time (JIT) provisioning and distribute an invite link that will allow those with the link to join the workspace.
option_D: Enable admins to invite their departments into the workspace so that new members are automatically added to the correct channels.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
Your company is on the Slack Business+ plan and is interested in setting up SCIM provisioning in their identity provider (IdP) to more efficiently manage their Slack user base.
Which two benefits would the company gain from using SCIM provisioning? (Select the TWO best answers.)
option_A: They can deactivate users automatically from their IdP.
option_B: Users only need to remember one set of credentials for all the applications they use.
option_C: They can sync custom profile fields to obtain more useful analytics about employees' Slack usage.
option_D: They do not have to pre-provision any users; employees will automatically create an account when they attempt to log in for the first time.
option_E: They can pre-provision Multi-Channel and Single-Channel Guests to their workspace.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
Brian, an HR manager, discovers an inappropriate custom emoji, and submits a request to Shonda, the Workspace Admin, to delete it.
How should Shonda address this request?
option_A: Navigate to the "Customize Slack" page and disable the addition of custom emoji, which will also remove existing custom emoji.
option_B: Inform Brian that you cannot delete an existing emoji, but can replace it with a more appropriate emoji.
option_C: Direct Brian to the "Customize Slack" page, where he can delete or replace the inappropriate emoji.
option_D: Navigate to the "Customize Slack" page, where Shonda can remove the custom emoji.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
You're a Workspace Owner at a small business that used Slack's Free plan in their first year. However, its business is growing fast enough to justify upgrading to a paid plan.
The requirements:
* Users want to be able to access their old messages and integrate Slack with their calendars.
* You want to use Okta to provision users in order to provide additional security and simplicity to the employee onboarding process.
* Field representatives need to be able to access Slack securely on their company-owned mobile devices.
Based on the requirements, what should you recommend?
(Select the best answer.)
option_A: Stay with the Slack Free plan for another year.
option_B: Move to the Slack Pro plan.
option_C: Move to the Slack Business+ plan.
option_D: Move to the Slack Enterprise Grid plan.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
You're a Workspace Owner who recently launched Slack at your company. Google Calendar is one of the essential productivity apps used by everyone in the company. You want to ensure that your colleagues can all access their Google Calendars from Slack.
What is the best way to enable the Google Calendar app for all members of your workspace?
(Select the best answer.)
option_A: Direct all users to integrate their Google Calendar app by posting instructions in your #announcements channel and linking to the app's page in the Slack Apps Directory.
option_B: Connect Google Calendar to your company's email domain, and enable domain-wide authentication for Google Calendar app in Slack to automatically install the app for all users.
option_C: Pre-approve the Google Calendar integration so users have the option to easily enable their own calendar apps.
option_D: Use the Admin API to automate approvals for Google Calendar app requests.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question: Your company is conducting an internal security assessment of Slack prior to implementation. Which of the following is true about security in Slack?
option_A: Slack data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
option_B: Slack data is stored on your company's servers.
option_C: Workspace Admins can see all direct message content at any time through the Admin console.
option_D: Slack members can only access Slack when on the corporate network.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
You work with a team of developers who are responsible for creating a custom ticketing app at your organization.
What should you do to ensure subject matter experts (SMEs) from the developer team are able to continuously manage settings for the custom app?
option_A: Encourage the developer team to use Workflow Builder to automate ticketing instead of creating a custom app.
option_B: Add the SMEs as internal app collaborators so they can directly manage the apps settings
option_C: Promote the SMEs to Org Admin so they can manage the custom app as well as all other apps installed at your organization.
option_D: Create a channel where the SMEs can submit suggested changes, and Org Admins can review and decide whether to apply the suggestions.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
You're a Workspace Admin looking to set up a user group for a new hire class your organization has recently hired.
What is a key benefit of setting up a user group for these individuals?
option_A: These users will only be granted access to the channels that they've been added to, ensuring that other organization channels remain confidential until they complete their onboarding.
option_B: The user group can then be added to all relevant new-hire and onboarding channels, ensuring that no one gets left behind or is accidentally excluded from any channels they should be in.
option_C: When writing a message from any of their workspaces on the Enterprise Grid, any member can send a notification to the new hires with one @mention.
option_D: Admins can foster a sense of community by creating a group-only direct message (DM).

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
You're the Primary Org Owner at a company with a large Slack Enterprise Grid org comprised of 10 workspaces. Each of these workspaces represents one of the company's individual business units. As the Primary Org Owner, you're focused on the administration of Slack rather than the business operations of each of the 10 units. Each business unit uses Slack differently.
How should you delegate responsibilities to best reflect the company's operating model?
option_A: Create a multi-workspace channel for selected members to manage all admin requests for the organization.
option_B: Delegate a Workspace Admin from each business unit to handle everyday tasks, such as member requests.
option_C: Delegate an org Owner from each business to handle everyday tasks, such as member requests.
option_D: Delegate an Org Admin from each business unit to handle everyday tasks, such as member requests

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
During a re-org within your organization, a decision is made to rename the Information Technology (IT) department to Business Technology (BT). As a result of this change, a large number of channels will need to update the prefix #it- to #bt-. The individual who created the #it-channels is no longer with the organization.
What is the most efficient strategy to ensure the channel prefixes are updated?
option_A: Join all public IT channels and request access to private chanpefs.in order to update the channel settings.
option_B: Use your preference menu to create an automatic keyword notification for IT and BT.
option_C: Promote members leading the IT to BT department name change initiative to the Channel Manager role In the key channels.
option_D: Write a script using the channels API to rename all channels with "#it-to "#bt-" in bulk.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
As a Workspace Owner on the Slack Business+ plan, you need to set message retention policies for your workspace. You'd like to keep important information in Slack so that employees can search for it, but there are a few channels with messages that you don't need to save for more than one month.
How should you set up your data retention policies?
(Select the best answer.)
option_A: Set your global message retention policies for one month, and adjust retention settings for important channels to keep everything.
option_B: Keep the default retention settings, but set a message retention policy of one month for channels with less important information.
option_C: Set the retention policy for public channels to keep all messages, and allow members to determine how long they'd like to keep messages in private channels.
option_D: Set the retention policy for private channels to keep everything, and set the retention policy for public channels to one month.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
You're the Grid Owner for your sales company's Slack Enterprise Grid instance. Departments are spread across multiple workspaces and collaborate with their customers through Slack Connect.
Your company is growing quickly, and you want to have more control over external collaboration. You decide to set up an external workspace dedicated to Slack Connect channels. This workspace should include all current users, plus any future users.
What is the easiest and most efficient way to go about adding users to the new workspace? (Select the best answer.)
option_A: Make the workspace a default workspace for all current and future users.
option_B: Use an org-wide default channel to introduce the new workspace and its purpose. Ask all users who are currently using Slack Connect to join the workspace.
option_C: Use the workspace's admin dashboard to add all users within your organization.
option_D: Sync all current and future users to the workspace using identity provider (IdP) groups.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
You're an Org Admin of an Enterprise Grid org consisting of three workspaces: IT, Internal and Contractors.
An executive at your company wants to create a communications channel with everyone in the IT and Internal workspace, but does nor want people in the Contractors workspace to see this channel.
What is the best way to create this channel so that it will only be visible to people in the IT and Internal workspaces?
(Select the best answer.)
option_A: Create an org-wide channel, and exclude the Contractors workspace.
option_B: Create a multi-workspace channel between the IT and Internal workspaces.
option_C: Create a channel in the IT workspace, and invite members from the Internal workspace as guests.
option_D: Create a Slack Connect channel between the IT and Internal workspaces.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question: At which point in the process should you claim your relevant domains for your Enterprise Grid organization?
option_A: Before purchasing Enterprise Grid. It is important to claim domains while still on the free plan.
option_B: Any time. Workspaces created prior to domain claiming will be shut down automatically.
option_C: As soon as possible. This feature is not retroactive, so workspaces created prior to claiming the domain will continue to exist as standalone workspaces.
option_D: Never. Slack will automatically claim the domains for you when you purchase Enterprise Grid.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
You're an Org Owner for your company's Slack Enterprise Grid org. Your team wants to add standardized user attributes to members' profiles using existing Identity Provider (IdP) data.
What is the best method to enable this process?
(Select the best answer.)
option_A: Use the Analytics API to sync attributes to your analytics dashboard.
option_B: Use the SCIM API to sync attributes to your member profiles.
option_C: Use the Custom Profile API to sync attributes to your analytics dashboard.
option_D: Create custom profile fields for members to add standard attributes to their profile.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
Cristina is evaluating a Slack app's security and notices that it has the following scopes present:
channels:write and chat:write:user.
Based on those scopes, which TWO actions can the app perform in Slack? (Choose two.)
option_A: Send messages as a member
option_B: Modify public channels
option_C: Access group direct messages
option_D: Upload files

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question: You re an Org Owner at a financial company and administer 20 workspaces on a Slack Enterprise Grid plan. Your company is concerned about staying in compliance with government-mandated regulatory requirements across all communication tools What is the first step you should take to ensure that communications remain compliant for your company9 (Select the best answer.)
option_A: Promote a member of your compliance team to Org Owner.
option_B: Implement a 24-hour retention policy in Slack to ensure that sensitive communications arc removed within a day.
option_C: Implement eDiscovery within Slack to ensure that all communications arc archived.
option_D: Meet with your compliance and legal teams to set policies for Slack at your company.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
You're the Workspace Primary Owner of a Slack Free plan. You want to allow all employees in your company to join your workspace when they're ready. You also want to prevent anyone outside your company from accessing your workspace without admin approval.
What should you do? (Select the best answer.)
option_A: Allow all workspace members to invite new members.
option_B: Invite all employees to the workspace by entering their email addresses in the invite flow from the workspace settings page.
option_C: Direct your employees to access Slack through your identity provider (IdP).
option_D: Enable employees to sign up for the workspace using the company's email domain.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
Large Corp is shutting down its Marketing team based in Europe. Deprovisioning is supported through their IdP.
When Large Corp removes users from their IdP, what will happen to their Slack accounts?
option_A: Their accounts will be deactivated, but they won't be signed out of their devices. A session reset is also required.
option_B: Their Slack accounts will be deleted permanently, and all messages and files will be deleted, as well, for compliance reasons.
option_C: Their accounts will be deactivated, they will be signed out on all of their devices, and their accounts will be removed from channels. However, only their messages and files in direct messages will be deleted.
option_D: Their accounts will be deactivated, they will be signed out on all of their devices, and their accounts will be removed from channels. However, their messages and files won't be deleted.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
As an Org Admin in your organization's Slack Enterprise Grid instance, you manage the existing four workspaces. Since your org is rapidly growing, you need a way to communicate upcoming trainings that are available to the entire company.
What is the best action to ensure these communications are seen in each current and future workspace?
(Select the best answer.)
option_A: Create a Slack Connect channel dedicated to company trainings.
option_B: Create an org-wide channel dedicated to company trainings.
option_C: Create a multi-workspace channel for training that exists in each workspace.
option_D: Have each Workspace Admin post in the correct public training channel.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
You're an Org Primary Owner on your company's Slack Enterprise Grid. You have six workspaces, each representing one line of business. Your company's Chief Information Officer (CIO) is keen on keeping all members of the organization informed about new Slack features on an ongoing basis.
How can you ensure all members are receiving ongoing enablement on new Slack features?
(Select the best answer.)
option_A: Leverage an org-wide channel to announce new Slack features on a recurring basis, and bookmark useful links and learning material in channel.
option_B: Advise Workspace Admins to direct all members to Slack's website to review new features.
option_C: Pin messages related to new Slack features in a dedicated multi-workspace channel on a recurring basis.
option_D: Direct members to a #help-slack channel to ask questions about new Slack features and receive feedback from your Slack Champions.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
You're the Primary Org Owner of your org's Slack Enterprise Grid instance. Your Slack instance is comprised of a Global workspace and six additional workspaces aligned to each business unit. Your organization's Chief Product Officer (CPO) is looking for an asynchronous way to share and demo a major product release to the entire company.
What is the most efficient way for the CPO to accomplish this?
(Select the best answer.)
option_A: Create a public channel in the Product & Engineering workspace for everyone to join and share the new product release announcement in channel.
option_B: Record a demo outside of Slack and import the file into a multi-workspace channel
option_C: Record a Slack Clip in an org-wide announcements channel to screen-share, and present the new product release.
option_D: Start a Huddle in an org-wide announcements channel to screen-share, and present the new product release.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
Your organization is on the Slack Enterprise Grid plan.
Which action can be performed by an Org Owner but not a Workspace Owner?
(Select the best answer.)
option_A: Reset all members' passwords.
option_B: Turn on approved apps.
option_C: Set message retention policies.
option_D: Manage single sign-on (SSO) settings.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
You're an Org Owner for your organizations Slack Enterprise Grid instance. Your organization has a number of Slack Connect channels used to communicate with your network of vendors. You're concerned that non-approved vendors will attempt to communicate with members of your organization without the proper vetting by your procurement team.
Which setting should you enable to prevent this from happening?
(Select the best answer.)
option_A: Set up the custom messaging in Guidelines for using Slack Connect with the policy for communicating with approved vendors only.
option_B: Disable the Use Slack Connect with free teams option so that only paid workspaces can access your slack Connect channels.
option_C: Adjust the slack connect for direct messages settings so that only org Admins and Org Owners can send and accept direct messages (DMs) from outside organizations.
option_D: Restrict Slack Connect to a specific workspace so that only users who have access to that workspace can also access your Slack Connect channels.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
Your organization is on the Slack Enterprise Grid plan.
What are three benefits of syncing identity provider (IdP) groups?
(Select the THREE best answers.)
option_A: Automatically adds or removes members of an Id group to workspaces within your org.
option_B: Makes membership for certain workspaces required to ensure that all members of an IdP group remain members of a workspace.
option_C: Automatically assigns system roles.
option_D: Automatically assigns approved apps to certain groups within your org.
option_F: Makes membership for certain channels required to ensure that all members of an laP group remain members of a channel.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
A finance team wants to nominate a team member to be a Slack Workspace Admin.
Which team member's prior experience would make them the optimal candidate for this role?
(Select the best answer)
option_A: The candidate encourages Slack etiquette in channels and frequently answers slack-related questions from colleagues. They provide feedback to the current Workspace Admins on Slack settings and policies at the company.
option_B: The candidate has experience creating custom integrations to improve the onboarding process for the company's new hires.
option_C: The candidate worked closely with the finance team to set up and request Slack Connect channels with external partners. They also helped design the process for approving Slack Connect channel requests at the company
option_D: The candidate relies on Slack in their day to day role and frequently asks the IT team questions about Slack features.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Salesforce-Slack-Administrator exam
question:
You're an Org Owner of a Slack Enterprise Grid org. Your company recently selected an Enterprise Mobility Management (EMM) provider and you will be turning on EMM. You're preparing a communication to share with your end users so they understand when they need to take action.
What guidance would you include in your communication?
(Select the best answer.)
option_A: End users will be signed out of Slack on their mobile devices if they do not complete the EMM setup within 72 hours.
option_B: End users will be signed out of Slack on their mobile devices if they do not complete the EMM setup within 24 hours.
option_C: End users will be immediately signed out of Slack on any unmanaged mobile devices.
option_D: End users will be signed out of Slack on their mobile devices if they do not complete the EMM setup within one week.
